decisions.reason: The stacking tray is a low-cost extension of the core pallet display business and fits the strategy of broadening 3D cardboard offerings.
The online customer portal supports the deeper customer collaboration and one-stop service the firm aims for, and digital tools are rarely withdrawn soon after launch.
The packaging display won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, which gives it high marketing value and strong reason to keep promoting it.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is a core standard format with its own web page and costs little to keep offering.
The counter display is a staple display type close to the established offer, with its own presentation page.
The large freestanding information display fits the firm's display-only portfolio and is promoted prominently on its own page.
